user.title: SWISSINNO BLE Setup
user.description: Automatically detects all SWISSINNO Bluetooth traps.

reset_no_connectable_device.message: No connectable Bluetooth receiver can reach Trap {address}. Move the Trap closer to a Bluetooth proxy or check that your proxies are connected.

reset_connection_failed.message: Could not connect to Trap {address} for the Reset: {error}. Try the Reset again.

reset_write_failed.message: Could not send the Reset to Trap {address}: {error}. Try the Reset again.

reset_characteristic_missing.message: Trap {address} does not offer the Reset characteristic. This Trap may not support Reset from Home Assistant.

reset_characteristic_not_writable.message: The Reset characteristic of Trap {address} is not writable (properties: {properties}).
